script.problem: The one line is more than one sentence.

terra.problem: The Ananias moment takes place in Damascus, not Tarsus. Acts 9:11 also does not say Ananias was sent to restore Saul’s sight; see Acts 9:12–17.
Saul’s sending happens from Caesarea, not in Tarsus. Acts 9:30 does not state that the Grecian Jews tried to kill him; that is in Acts 9:29.
Both moments in which Paul speaks about Tarsus take place in Jerusalem, not Tarsus.
“Grecian Jews” and “zealous” may be difficult for a 5th-grade reader. Consider “Greek-speaking Jews” and “deeply devoted to God.”
